rules.posture: Choose bending for the action target, obstacles, joint margin and smooth motion. Elbow extension for electrode pickup is a soft preference; never impose a universal elbow height or direction.
rules.support_and_release: Release only after the action-specific fixture/support geometry checks; support cannot be invented or moved during an action.
rules.grasp_and_attachment: Use existing measured gap/alignment gates before attachment; preserve the held orientation unless an explicitly supported rigid attachment rotation is implemented.
rules.motion: Reject nonfinite/looping plans; stop significant repeated oscillation, nonconvergent corrections, declared joint-limit violations, or modeled hardware clearance violations; require the robot asset to enable PhysX self-collision solving.
rules.cables: Preserve the declared cable arc length, segment length, endpoints and static obstacle clearance; do not claim calibrated tension, self-contact or bend-force validation.
rules.liquid_and_material: Keep existing transfer-session receipt gates, actual quantities, residues, waste and conservation checks; never change inventory for appearance.
rules.causality: Commit experiment state only after successful action receipts; retain failed/uncertain state and original evidence.

parameter_basis.position_deadband_m: Existing 5 mm controller convergence scale; a numerical anti-oscillation setting, not calibrated hardware precision.
parameter_basis.orientation_deadband_deg: Existing 2 degree registered-pose reuse threshold; used to avoid unrequested held-object turns.
parameter_basis.significant_reversals_before_stop: Project engineering stop policy: three excursions larger than the deadband. Not a universal physical constant.
parameter_basis.maximum_local_corrections: Project engineering attempt budget including the first observed arrival; stop and replan instead of repeated physical trial motions.
parameter_basis.transit_clearance_m: Conservative 5 mm planning allowance based on the existing controller scale; not manufacturer clearance or calibration.
parameter_basis.registered_transit_z_m: Preserve the previously registered high-route workspace; geometry selects a height within it, never raises the ceiling silently.
parameter_basis.numeric_tolerance: Floating-point tolerance only; cannot be used as an operational clearance.
parameter_basis.self_collision: Require the selected robot asset to explicitly enable PhysX self-collision solving; this does not certify continuous inter-step collision avoidance.
